description: Needs an account. A signed-in agent tells the distribution team about a problem or an idea with any API key. As a guest this sends nothing: it answers with claim, where to sign in and create a key, so the report can be sent from an account.

context.description: Where it happened: the tool, request id, URL, error code and HTTP status. Other keys are dropped.

request_id.description: The request id from an error, if any.

url.description: A page or endpoint; only its origin and path are kept.

details.description: What happened (the exact error), how to repeat it (the call), what you expected. Identifiers only.

kind.description: bug, gap (a missing capability or an empty or wrong field), idea, praise or other.

title.description: One line: what happened or what is missing.

name: feedback_send
title: Send feedback
